stepTitle: Make Claude plan approval a required step in the core LBYL planning contract
acceptanceCriteria: The conductor, writing-plans, and persistent-plans skills explicitly name those four triggers and describe Claude attack-plan approval as required whenever they apply rather than optional, and the parity doc reflects both the required approval rule and explorer as a Claude-bundle capability.

findings.summary: persistent-plans does not list the four trigger conditions
findings.detail: The acceptance criteria require 'The conductor, writing-plans, and persistent-plans skills explicitly name those four triggers'. The conductor (lines 256-259) and writing-plans (lines 315-318) both enumerate the four triggers: large/high-blast-radius, materially revised Codex draft, fragile sequencing/verification, and explicit user request. The persistent-plans file only contains the compound label 'required-Claude-attack-when-triggered' on line 232 with no enumeration of the individual triggers. A Codex session reading only persistent-plans would not know which conditions make the Claude attack pass required.
